_about: Public-domain Louis Bourdaloue (1632-1704, Jesuit preacher at the court of Louis XIV) in English for the Word Hoard: Select Sermons (Harlow, 1806), Sermons and Moral Discourses tr. A. Carroll (2 vols, Dublin, 1843), Spiritual Exercises for a seven days' retreat ed. Orby Shipley (1868), The Spiritual Retreat (1885), Eight Sermons for Holy Week and Easter tr. G. F. Crowther, and two Versailles sermons tr. Alicia du Pont de Nemours (New York, 1919), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 26 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Translators recorded per item where the title page names one; every printing dated or catalogued before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
